facts.title: chile-lime melon salad
ingredients: 4 cups chopped or balled melon (from about 1 cantaloupe or honeydew, or 1/4 a large watermelon)
Juice of half a lime, divided, plus more to taste
1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro, plus more to taste
facts.yield_text: 2 hungry people or 4 as a side
facts.author: Deb Perelman
